<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % internalEntity "Parsed internal entity content">
  <!ENTITY % paramEntity "<!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | sub)*> <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>">
  %paramEntity;
  <!ENTITY externalRef SYSTEM "http://localhost/external.ent">
]><root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Root level comment explaining the structure -->
  <?xml-debug target="parser" data="start"?>
  <section sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like text: <sub:item>&internalEntity;</sub:item>
    ]]>
    &externalRef;
  </section>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?target-pi data="processing-instruction-value"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (description)*>
  <!ELEMENT description (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e-base "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY e-ref "&e-base; with extension">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY % markup-macro "<!ATTLIST item cat-id CDATA #REQUIRED>">
  %markup-macro;
]><catalog xmlns="http://w3.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- First comment block -->
  <item cat-id="cat-001" xlink:type="simple">
    <?another-pi query="true"?>
    <description>
      <![CDATA[
        Nested CDATA with special symbols: <item>&e-ref;</item>
      ]]>
    </description>
  </item>
  <!-- Second comment block -->
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (header, body)>
  <!ELEMENT header (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second Entity">
  <!ENTITY % pEnt "<!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA | note)*> <!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %pEnt;
]>
<document xmlns="http://xml.org/document" xmlns:meta="http://xml.org/meta" xmlns:ns="http://xml.org/ns">
  <!-- Document Header Comment -->
  <?meta-pi action="init"?>
  <header meta:version="1.0">
    <![CDATA[
      Header CDATA block with entities: &ent2;
    ]]>
  </header>
  <body ns:role="primary">
    Normal body text referencing entities: &ent2;
  </body>
</document>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-rpc service="dispatcher"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha Entity">
  <!ENTITY beta "α -> Beta Entity">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY documetation SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % dtd-ext "<!ELEMENT record (title, content)> <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)> <!ELEMENT content (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtd-ext;
]>
<archive xmlns="http://xml.org/archive" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Archive Metadata Comment -->
  <?dc-pi creator="system"?>
  <record>
    <title>
      <![CDATA[
        Record Title with CDATA & entities: β
      ]]>
    </title>
    <content>
      β
    </content>
  </record>
</archive>
```

<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<!DOCTYPE enterprise [
  <!ELEMENT enterprise (department)*>
  <!ELEMENT department (employee)*>
  <!ELEMENT employee (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY corp "Corporation Name">
  <!ENTITY subsidiary "&corp; - Subsidiary">
  <!ENTITY % entity-macro "<!ATTLIST department code ID #REQUIRED>">
  %entity-macro;
]>
<enterprise xmlns="http://xml.org/enterprise" xmlns:hr="http://xml.org/hr" xmlns:fin="http://xml.org/fin">
  <!-- Enterprise root comment block -->
  <?hr-pi department="engineering" action="audit"?>
  <department code="D01" hr:manager="John Doe">
    <employee>
      <![CDATA[
        Employee record containing internal CDATA and entity reference: &subsidiary;
      ]]>
    </employee>
  </department>
</enterprise>
